topic: Inventory management plan and schema updates
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the status of inventory management tasks. One participant noted needing a plan for inventory management, as the scope was unclear.

Another participant mentioned immediate tasks including work with Galina and implementing a JSON schema for assets. This is considered a major, foundational change, starting with a default schema that can later be customized per company.

A third participant recalled having broken the saving functionality (which could be simplified to accommodate the new schema) and noted the need to integrate S3 storage and implement import/export features. They also mentioned updating the Hong Kong firmware, which seemed more stable.
decisions: Implement a default JSON schema for assets first
Integrate S3 functionality for saving data
action_items: Create a plan for inventory management tasks
Fix the broken save functionality to accommodate the new asset schema
